verdict.rationale: Notte runs web agents, so letting users attach external MCP servers to those agents is a fair question for this product. The evidence only shows Notte acting as an MCP server that other agents connect to (CrewAI, Vercel AI SDK clients pointing at the Notte MCP server). That is the opposite role. Nothing in the pack shows Notte's own agents consuming tools from user-supplied MCP servers.
